column1: # The Lean test runs the gate (scripts/gate-lean.sh) executes, one per line; the coverage check takes its entry points from here.
# Columns, tab separated: id, mode, file, argument, needle.
#   ok:     the run exits 0 and a line ends with the needle.   refuse: the run exits non-zero and the output carries the needle.
#   stub:   a lake exe run with a failing ImageMagick convert on PATH (the gate runs it; the module is the exe root).
